Page-pass draft 'فطلبه' is 'قد طلبه' on the master, 'لعشيه' is 'العشيه'.
notes: Segmenter overcounts (14/17/14/9): it counts the dotted dividers' stems and the final line-end dividers. 36v (image 77) ends with Arabic l.13 'wa-katabtu tahtaha al-jawab' and a catchword at bottom left that reads like 'سر' (does not match the first sign of 37r); images 77 and 78 show the fore-edge on opposite sides. Answered = yes for the signs present (all 49 read by the red gloss and the plaintext); but the cipher covers only the last 11 words of the 19-word plaintext, so its start may be lost.

The few clashes are my look-alike signs (E for ت/ح/خ). Readings the cipher implies for 21r: l.12 وخمد is يحمد; جمالها is جملها; للراكبان is للراكب ان; منها ما written as one group.
recheck.most_frequent_sign: the '4-ayn' sign a is 17 of 58 (29%) on the sample but 45 of 227 (20%) over the block, not a third; it is a letter, alif: it stands at group starts, middles and ends (14/18/13), one group is a + a2 + a (= اذا), so it cannot be a null, and it is never used where the dotted-stem dividers stand. V (numeral-7 shape), often line-initial, is و, not a line marker.
recheck.riddle_verses_1_5: tested: 209 letters, 56 words; best alignment of their word lengths with the group lengths gives only 12 equal of 45 (raw) or 14 of 47 (with a removed); the 47r key does not read the block. Not the missing cipher of verses 1-5.
recheck.verses_49r: not this block's: they answer the new block 49r.1 (42 signs) in part
recheck.compiler_remarks: heading 48r l.7 reads ورابعها on the master ('and the fourth of them'), the series of 19r وثانيها and 20r وثالث المترجمات; no solving remark survives: the block breaks off at the foot of 48v and 49r opens with another piece, so a leaf is probably lost between ff. 48 and 49 (it would hold the last 15 words of the cipher and the solution remark). The 49r remarks (فلم تنحل الا بعد تعب كثير ...) belong to 49r.1.
